description:
Hushfeed v0.67.1 has 106 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Every button Hushfeed draws on videos now starts off, and all five sit together under Feed screen > Buttons on videos. If you used the mute button, turn it back on there. Playback holds every player switch, and screenshots and the status bar moved to App > System. Your saved choices stay as they were.

The hide and block sound buttons work without the block button. A TikTok that carries a single language patches with everything selected. Limit background traffic keeps push setup by default, and streaks say "Sent to n/n chats" when every message went out. See the changelog for the full list.

Validation: 2785 runtime tests passed and 545 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 106 patches applied to all three supported APKs with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. The video buttons and the regrouped settings were checked on a Samsung phone running TikTok 47.0.3.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
